column1: # figure: Supplementary Note 5 Figure 1a, coexpression-preserving nulls

# script: analyses/suppnote5_coexpr_null_2026-10-13/coexpr_null.py (remote environment) + summarize.py; list set 'core80': 71 lists, 2485 pairs, scenario 'published, brain', rule A primary lists (analyses/primary_lists.json sha256 44fb07b1d2e5)

# statistics as fairness_lists/a5b_go.py (GO BP 5-200 genes; top pathways = up to 20 terms with p < 0.01 and >= 2 hits; mean pathway/gene Jaccard and shared totals over pairs); genes_in_k_or_more_lists = annotated tested genes that are hits in >= k lists

# nulls: uniform_independent and de_prior_independent = a5b_go.py's draws (re-run here); rot_* = each list's hits moved by one circular shift along the GTEx v8 cortex co-expression ordering (rotation_lib.py of addendum 4a), within strata S0 (none) or 40 equal-count DE-prior bins; R1 lists shifted independently, R2 lists of one cohort cluster shifted together; 1000 draws each, seed 20261013

# log2_lo95 / log2_hi95 = log2 of observed over the null's upper / lower 95% limit (as fig12 panel a); p_upper = (1 + replicates >= observed) / (1 + n); jack_list / jack_cluster = ratio x exp(+-1.96 SE) of a delete-one jackknife over lists (units) / cohort clusters (a multi-bank study sits in each of its clusters), pair metrics only

# 2026-10-21: columns jack_cluster_lo, jack_cluster_hi, jack_cluster_n_units from the stored replicates with the cohort-cluster sets (20 clusters of the 71 lists); in the rot_R2 rows a list that spans several clusters is shifted on its own, because it cannot move together with more than one cluster
